lines: Be it remembered that on the tenth day of August Anno Domini Seventeen hundred and ninety five,
Letters of Administration on the estate of Thomas Durham dec'd were in due form of Law granted unto
Thomas Hughes, who being sworn gave bond in the sum of two hundred pounds lawful money with
Hugh Talbot surity for their faithful discharge thereof as the bond filed may appear.

Thomas Hughes, who being sworn gave bond in the sum of two hundred pounds lawful money with
Hugh Talbot surity for their faithful discharge thereof as the bond filed may appear.
